build_input: Matching installed LLVM development headers and static archives, selected by LLVM_CONFIG_PATH; no network downloads during build
builtin_headers: Compiler-owned resource tree from the same LLVM installation, compressed per file at build time; content identity becomes part of the analysis fingerprint
modifications: LLVM sources are not modified. Native bridge, frontend, filesystem, visitor and per-TU resource guards are KodStar-owned adapters.

cxx.source: LLVM installation include/c++/v1, including its generated target ABI __config_site

darwin.build_input: KODSTAR_ZIG_LIB_PATH or Homebrew Zig 0.17.0; raw files are not modified
darwin.license: Original file-level APSL-2.0, BSD and MIT notices; LICENSES/native/Apple-APSL-2.0.txt and Zig-LICENSE.txt
darwin.digest_contract: Sorted virtual system/ paths: u64 little-endian UTF-8 name length, name bytes, BLAKE3 of unmodified file bytes
